# IAM actions the lagotto CLI calls

<!-- Generated by `make cli-iam-actions` (internal/iamcoverage, #206). Do not edit by hand. -->

The lagotto CLI runs with **your** AWS credentials, so every action below is one
your IAM identity needs for the command that calls it. (The hosted poller runs
as its own role, whose policy `lagotto setup` writes; that is not this list.)
The list is discovered from the code, not maintained by hand: the generator
type-checks the CLI, builds its call graph, and records every AWS SDK operation
reachable from each command's run function, including calls made through spawn
and truffle. CI fails when the code and this page disagree, so a new AWS call
cannot ship without appearing here.

How to read it:

- **It over-approximates.** A command is listed with every action any of its
  code paths can reach, including flags you may not use and error paths.
  `lagotto poll` runs the poller locally, so it needs what the hosted poller's
  role has, including launching instances with `--action spawn`.
- **Tag-on-create and `iam:PassRole` are listed wherever the operation is
  reachable**, whether or not that command sets tags or passes a role:
  `ec2:RunInstances` also needs `ec2:CreateTags` (tags) and `iam:PassRole`
  (an instance profile), `scheduler:CreateSchedule` needs `iam:PassRole` on the
  role the schedule assumes (`lagotto-capacity-poller-scheduler-invoke`), and so on.
- **It names actions, not resources.** Grant `iam:PassRole` on the specific
  roles, not on `*`.
- `sts:GetCallerIdentity` needs no permission and is omitted.

## Outside any command

What runs outside every command's own code: startup and the root command's
persistent pre-run (the `--account` guard):

None.

## Everyday commands: what they need beyond lagotto's tables

The commands a watch user runs day to day, and the actions each needs besides
`dynamodb:*` on lagotto's own tables (`lagotto-watches`, `lagotto-match-history`,
`lagotto-scheduled-launches`). These are the ones a user who was granted only the
tables is missing. The administrator commands are listed after the table.

| Command | Beyond the tables |
| --- | --- |
| `lagotto ack` | `iam:PassRole`, `scheduler:GetSchedule`, `scheduler:UpdateSchedule`, `sns:GetSubscriptionAttributes`, `sns:ListSubscriptionsByTopic`, `sns:Subscribe` |
| `lagotto cancel` | `ec2:CancelCapacityReservation`, `ec2:DescribeCapacityReservations`, `sns:GetSubscriptionAttributes`, `sns:ListSubscriptionsByTopic`, `sns:Unsubscribe` |
| `lagotto doctor` | `cloudformation:DescribeStacks`, `cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics`, `ec2:DescribeInstanceTypeOfferings`, `ec2:DescribeRegions`, `ec2:DescribeSubnets`, `iam:GetRole`, `iam:GetRolePolicy`, `lambda:GetFunction`, `s3:GetBucketTagging`, `s3:ListAllMyBuckets`, `scheduler:GetSchedule`, `scheduler:ListSchedules`, `sns:GetSubscriptionAttributes`, `sns:GetTopicAttributes`, `sns:ListSubscriptionsByTopic` |
| `lagotto extend` | `iam:PassRole`, `scheduler:GetSchedule`, `scheduler:UpdateSchedule`, `sns:GetSubscriptionAttributes`, `sns:ListSubscriptionsByTopic`, `sns:Subscribe` |
| `lagotto history` | nothing |
| `lagotto launch` | `ec2:DescribeCapacityReservations`, `iam:PassRole`, `lambda:GetFunction`, `s3:GetObject`, `scheduler:CreateSchedule` |
| `lagotto list` | `sns:GetSubscriptionAttributes`, `sns:ListSubscriptionsByTopic` |
| `lagotto notify-gc` | `iam:PassRole`, `sns:GetSubscriptionAttributes`, `sns:GetTopicAttributes`, `sns:ListSubscriptionsByTopic`, `sns:Subscribe`, `sns:Unsubscribe` |
| `lagotto status` | `sns:GetSubscriptionAttributes`, `sns:ListSubscriptionsByTopic` |
| `lagotto update` | `ec2:DescribeInstanceTypeOfferings`, `ec2:DescribeInstances`, `ec2:DescribeRegions`, `ec2:DescribeSubnets`, `iam:GetRole`, `iam:GetRolePolicy`, `iam:PassRole`, `s3:GetObject`, `scheduler:GetSchedule`, `scheduler:UpdateSchedule`, `servicequotas:GetServiceQuota`, `sns:GetSubscriptionAttributes`, `sns:GetTopicAttributes`, `sns:ListSubscriptionsByTopic`, `sns:Subscribe`, `sns:Unsubscribe` |
| `lagotto version` | nothing |
| `lagotto watch` | `ec2:DescribeInstanceTypeOfferings`, `ec2:DescribeInstances`, `ec2:DescribeRegions`, `ec2:DescribeSubnets`, `iam:GetRole`, `iam:GetRolePolicy`, `iam:PassRole`, `s3:GetObject`, `scheduler:GetSchedule`, `scheduler:UpdateSchedule`, `servicequotas:GetServiceQuota`, `sns:GetSubscriptionAttributes`, `sns:GetTopicAttributes`, `sns:ListSubscriptionsByTopic`, `sns:Subscribe` |

Not everyday use:

- `lagotto deploy`: administrator: creates the poller's Lambda, topic, schedule, tables and IAM roles.
- `lagotto poll`: runs the poller locally, so it needs what the hosted poller's role has.
- `lagotto setup`: administrator: creates the tables and both IAM roles, and writes their policies.
- `lagotto teardown`: administrator: deletes lagotto's DynamoDB tables and, with --iam-roles, its IAM roles.
